title: Object Storage bucket returns 5xx errors
description: Notifies when an Object Storage bucket returns server errors, including responses throttled by the per-bucket rate limit.

definition.name: [Akamai Cloud Pulse] Bucket {{bucket.name}} is returning 5xx errors
definition.message:
Bucket `{{bucket.name}}` returned {{value}} 5xx responses in the last 15 minutes.

Compare with `akamai_cloud_pulse.objectstorage.responses_rate_limited`: if most errors are rate limited, reduce the request rate or spread the load across buckets.
